nodes.asset_description: Composite cutout of fashion items arranged on a light beige background: top-center black oversized cat-eye sunglasses; left mid a blue denim jacket on a thin silver hanger with button details; right mid a white short-sleeve polo shirt with thin orange-red horizontal stripes and a light gray collar; lower-right a pair of light-blue distressed jeans crossing at the ankles with ripped patches; lower-left a white handbag with tan leather handles/trim and gold hardware; bottom-left a pair of beige suede chunky-sole derby shoes with thick black rubber tread, one shoe angled with visible outsole lugs. Items are evenly spaced forming a loose grid.
